summary_en: HIP Corporation authorized acquisition of up to 80,000 shares (2.1% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of ¥130 million through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from November 5, 2026 through November 4, 2027, to enable flexible capital allocation in response to changing business conditions.
title_en: Notification of Determination of Matters Relating to Acquisition of Treasury Stock (Acquisition of Treasury Stock Based on Articles of Incorporation Pursuant to the Provisions of Article 165, Paragraph 2 of the Companies Act)
translation_en_brief:
On November 4, 2026, HIP Corporation's Board of Directors authorized the acquisition of treasury stock under the Companies Act. The company will acquire up to 80,000 shares of its common stock, representing 2.1% of outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock), for a maximum total expenditure of ¥130 million.

The acquisition will be conducted through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange under a discretionary trading agreement, with the acquisition period running from November 5, 2026 through November 4, 2027. At September 30, 2026, the company held 170,109 treasury shares against 3,805,191 outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock).

The company stated that the buyback authorization is intended to enable flexible capital policy execution in response to changes in the operating environment.
